q1.explanationZh: 文章第一句就说他是匈牙利的玩具摄影师。

evidence.quote: Benedek Lampert is a Hungarian toy photographer.

q2.explanationZh: 第二段最后两句：做一团烟用棉花，做雪用糖粉。两种材料都要写。

evidence.quote: to create a plume of smoke, he uses cotton. For snow, he uses powdered sugar

q3.sampleAnswer: Because he needs a beach scene for his photos.

keyPoints.descZh: 他需要海滩场景来拍照

q3.explanationZh: 第三段说，如果需要海滩场景，他就带着乐高去最近的海边。

evidence.quote: If he needs a beach scene, he’ll take his LEGO set with him and go to the nearest seaside.

q4.sampleAnswer: Because he wants to make the best use of nature to make his pictures more lively and realistic.

keyPoints.descZh: 充分利用自然光，让照片更生动真实
examples: make the best use of nature
make his pictures more lively and realistic

q4.rubricZh: 要点：利用自然光，使照片更生动真实。开放性推断，言之有理即可。
q4.explanationZh: 第三段说他很会利用大自然，想要下午的光线就等真正的日落。真的阳光比灯光更自然，照片更生动。

evidence.quote: When he wants to use the light of afternoon for a picture, he’ll wait for an actual sunset.

q5.sampleAnswer: He has won many fans, and some brands have invited him to shoot advertisements with LEGO toys.

keyPoints.descZh: 照片为他赢得了很多粉丝
examples: won him a lot of fans

keyPoints.descZh: 一些品牌邀请他用乐高拍广告
examples: brands have invited him to shoot advertisements

q5.rubricZh: 要点：赢得很多粉丝；品牌邀请他拍广告。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段给了两个成功的表现：照片让他有很多粉丝；有品牌请他拍广告。

evidence.quote: The lively and creative pictures taken by Lampert have won him a lot of fans.
some brands have even invited him to shoot advertisements with LEGO toys!

q6.sampleAnswer: I would use blue plastic wrap for water because it looks shiny and moves easily. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 说出一个日常物品及其效果

examples: because it looks shiny and moves easily

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：写出物品和理由。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题：先说用什么物品做什么效果，再用 because 说一个合理的理由。

evidence.quote: For example, to create a plume of smoke, he uses cotton.
